text:
adarsh: Quick heads-up — after onboarding int8-v2 on perf cluster I see output drift for very long contexts when prefetch + sticky window is enabled. Repro below, small prompt but if you pad to ~70k tokens the generations diverge. :thinking:

leah: ouch, can you paste the exact curl and diff?

adarsh: sure — minimal repro (run on dedicated int8-v2 perftest)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"int8-v2","max_tokens":128,"prompt":"<pad 65000> The answer is"}'
```

adarsh: expected: "The answer is 42"

adarsh: actual:   "The answ er is 42"  <-- subtle tokenization shift mid-output when seq_len ~65536

ci-bot: [smoke-run] ran 10 requests; 2 failures matching divergence at seq_len=65536. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-eval-smoke/longspan/1717777777/

kate: did we change RoPE scaling or rotary embedding prefix handling on the int8 execution path recently?

ian: not directly, but the prefetch flow was modified to use fractional tile offsets to reduce memory copy. If a tile is partially filled at the window edge we might be copying the wrong KV slice.

maria: can you repro with prefetch disabled?

adarsh: yes — disabling prefetch removes the divergence. So far looks like prefetch + sticky-window alignment bug.

leah: next actions: (1) add a unit test reproducing edge alignment in runtime/tests/kv_alignment_test.py, (2) add kv-tile fingerprints to debug logs, (3) open ticket INF-4921 with steps + logs, (4) try tile_size=512/1024 to see sensitivity.

adarsh: created INF-4921: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4921 — comments + logs attached. Also pushed branch adarsh/kv-prefetch-align-fix

kate: good. once you have a fix let's canary on dedicated (gpu-a100-4) and run our eval suite to check for quality regressions.

ci-bot: Canary scheduled: dedicated/gpu-a100-4 — 2h window starting 2024-05-02T03:00:00Z. Will run eval suite and smoke tests.

ian: quick heuristic to mitigate: don't prefetch across a boundary when (token_count % tile_size) < 32 — reduces chance of partial-tile copy.

maria: also adding kv fingerprint SHA1(tile_bytes) to logs will let us detect if merged tiles differ across prefetch vs direct copy.

adarsh: running long-run eval (20 seeds) now; I'll post metrics and diffs when complete.

leah: thanks for handling. please @channel when INF-4921 has the fix merged. :eyes:
